questions.question:
[경로: Ephedrine 생합성]
다음 경로에서 ★로 표시한 물질의 이름은?

[[rxn:NC(Cc1ccccc1)C(=O)O>>OC(=O)c1ccccc1|cinnamic acid 경유 곁사슬 분해]]

(benzoic acid → (−)-cathinone)

(−)-cathinone →(환원)→ (−)-norephedrine
(−)-norephedrine →(SAM)→ (−)-ephedrine

(S)-norcoclaurine →(SAM (6-O-메틸))→ (S)-coclaurine

(S)-N-methylcoclaurine →(수산화(ascorbate), SAM)→ (S)-reticuline

questions.question:
[경로: Tryptophan → indole alkaloid]
다음 경로에서 ★로 표시한 물질의 이름은?

[[rxn:NC(Cc1c[nH]c2ccccc12)C(=O)O>>NCCc1c[nH]c2ccccc12|TDC (−CO₂)]]
(★ → tryptamine)

[[rxn:NCCc1c[nH]c2ccccc12>>COC(=O)C1=COC(OC2OC(CO)C(O)C(O)C2O)C(C=C)C1CC1NCCc2c1[nH]c1ccccc21|secologanin, strictosidine synthase]]
(tryptamine → strictosidine)
questions.explanation:
정답: L-tryptophan
전체 경로:
L-tryptophan →(TDC (−CO₂))→ tryptamine
tryptamine →(secologanin, strictosidine synthase)→ strictosidine
strictosidine →(corynantheal → cinchoninone (indole 재배열))→ quinine
참고: strictosidine → vindoline + catharanthine → vinblastine / → camptothecin
그림:
[[img:pharmacognosy/local/alk-p47.png|PPT alk-p47]]
[[img:pharmacognosy/local/alk-p56.png|PPT alk-p56]]
